candidate.answerReason: For sides a, b, c opposite angles A, B, C, the cosine law gives cos A = (b² + c² − a²)/(2bc). Three known sides therefore directly determine an angle's cosine.

methods.label: Select the law of cosines
methods.explanation: When all three sides are known, the law of cosines can directly give the cosine of an angle.
methods.levelReason: Selecting the cosine law from three known sides is standard high-school triangle solving.
